dialect.detail: JMA ORCA medical receipt software (日医標準レセプトソフト); uses GnuCOBOL/OpenCOBOL conventions with COPY includes (.INC files), ORCMCPSUB DB access pattern, and ORCSJOB job management calls typical of the ORCA system

purpose.domain_detail: Japanese medical insurance receipt (レセプト) processing system - specifically symptom detail (症状詳記) printing for social insurance and national insurance claims
purpose.summary: ORCBM510 is a batch program in the JMA ORCA medical receipt system that reads receipt calculation data and generates symptom detail (症状詳記) print output. It processes claim management records, patient information, and insurance data to compose formatted print pages for medical insurance claim submissions.

notable_features: Heavy use of COPY includes (24 copybooks) for modular data definitions
UNSTRING of comma-delimited COMMAND-PARAM for parameter passing
CALL to ORCMCPSUB for database access (ORCA MCP pattern)
CALL to ORCSJOB for job management
Japanese text in comments and data values (Shift-JIS/EUC-JP encoded)
EVALUATE used extensively for insurance type classification
No EXEC SQL or EXEC CICS - uses proprietary ORCA DB abstraction
PERFORM VARYING with multiple UNTIL conditions
LINKAGE SECTION with COMMAND-PARAM for shell invocation
verdict.notes: Source is encoded in EUC-JP or Shift-JIS (decoded as latin-1 causing mojibake in comments and string literals). This is clearly production code from the open-source JMA ORCA medical receipt system, a well-known Japanese healthcare IT platform. The 24 COPY statements and 24 CALLs indicate a large modular system. Truncated at 16000 chars but enough is visible to classify confidently.
